		}
	}

void dfs_memo_b(int pos, int cnt_a, int cnt_b, i64 current_sum = 0)

		return;
	}
	FOR(choice, 0, 2)
	{
		if (constraints[pos - 1] != -1 && choice != constraints[pos - 1]) continue;
		i64 contribution = 0;
		if (choice == 0)

        count_min_abs = cnt;
    } else if (val == min_abs) {
        count_min_abs += cnt;
    }
}

void dfs_b(int pos, int cnt_a, int cnt_b, i64 sum = 0) {
    if (pos == mid) {
        memo_b[cnt_a][cnt_b].emplace_back(sum, 1);
        return;
    }
    for (int choice = 0; choice < 2; ++choice) {
        if (fixed_constraints[pos-1] != -1 && choice != fixed_constraints[pos-1]) continue;
        i64 contribution = 0;
        if (choice == 0 && cnt_a > 0) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                contribution += C[cnt_a-1][n-1] * C[cnt_b][j] * C[N-pos][n-j];
            }
            dfs_b(pos-1, cnt_a-1, cnt_b, sum + contribution);
        } else if (choice == 1 && cnt_b > 0) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                contribution -= C[cnt_b-1][n-1] * C[cnt_a][j] * C[N-pos][n-j];
            }
            dfs_b(pos-1, cnt_a, cnt_b-1, sum + contribution);
        }
    }
}

void bfs_a() {
    for (int i = 0; i <= n+m; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= n+m; ++j) {
            memo_a[i][j].clear();
        }
    }
    memo_a[0][0][0] = 1;
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= n+m; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= n+m; ++j) {
            for (auto &[cur_sum, cnt] : memo_a[i][j]) {
                if (i + j == mid) {
                    auto it = lower_bound(memo_b[i][j].begin(), memo_b[i][j].end(), make_pair(-cur_sum, -1));
                    if (it != memo_b[i][j].end()) {
                        update_min(abs(cur_sum + it->first), cnt * it->second);
                    }
                    if (it != memo_b[i][j].begin()) {
                        --it;
                        update_min(abs(cur_sum + it->first), cnt * it->second);
                    }
                } else {
                    int idx = i + j;
                    for (int choice = 0; choice < 2; ++choice) {
                        if (fixed_constraints[idx] != -1 && choice != fixed_constraints[idx]) continue;
                        int na = i, nb = j;
                        if (choice == 0) ++na;
                        else ++nb;
                        if (na <= n+m && nb <= n+m) {
                            i64 delta = 0;
                            if (choice == 0) {
                                for (int l = 0; l < n; ++l) {
                                    delta += C[na-1][n-1] * C[nb][l] * C[N-idx-1][n-l];
                                }
                            } else {
                                for (int l = 0; l < n; ++l) {
                                    delta -= C[nb-1][n-1] * C[na][l] * C[N-idx-1][n-l];
                                }
                            }
                            memo_a[na][nb][cur_sum + delta] += cnt;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

void process() {
    for (int i = 0; i <= n+m; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= n+m; ++j) {
            memo_b[i][j].clear();
        }
    }
    dfs_b(N, n+m, n+m);
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= n+m; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= n+m; ++j) {
            sort(memo_b[i][j].begin(), memo_b[i][j].end());
            vector<pair<i64, int>> merged;
            int sz = memo_b[i][j].size();
            for (int k = 0; k < sz; ) {
                i64 val = memo_b[i][j][k].first;
                int total = 0;
                while (k < sz && memo_b[i][j][k].first == val) {
                    total += memo_b[i][j][k].second;
                    ++k;
                }
                merged.emplace_back(val, total);
            }
            memo_b[i][j] = move(merged);
        }
    }
    bfs_a();
}
